DeployBot: initiating staged rollout service=inference-api model=v2.8.0 cohort=EMEA initial=1% planned-bump=10% after 8m soak. /deploy start --staged=1%
Ava: FYI this includes a minor tokenizer alignment + batching change. Recommend 1% smoke then evaluate token_count and 5xx.
Ken (oncall): holding until auth and p99 stable for 5m. If auth.fail.delta >0.5% call stop.
Infra: pinning canary to driver-stable pool and setting hotstart-throttle=5s.
DeployBot: canary active at 1%. Monitoring hooks: auth.fail, latency.p99, request.5xx, tokenizer.token_count.delta.
MetricsBot: at +3m tokenizer.token_count.delta=+0.6%, auth.fail.delta=0.0%, request.5xx=0.02%.
Ava: looks clean. Propose bump to 10% after 8m soak.
Ken (oncall): +1 but will watch p99; if p99 > baseline+100ms or 5xx >0.5% I will call stop.
DeployBot: bumping to 10% now `/deploy bump --staged=10%`
MetricsBot: at +1m post-bump request.5xx spiked to 1.2% (threshold 0.5%) and latency.p99 +220ms.
Ken (oncall): calling stop. High 5xx and p99 tail. Initiate rollback to v2.7.4.
DeployBot: stop acknowledged. executing rollback `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.7.4`
Infra: scaling down v2.8.0 pods, reinstating v2.7.4; expect ~45s warmstart bleed.
Ava: will revert batching change in candidate and run extended staging tokenized suite.
ReleaseNotesBot: note added: "v2.8.0 EMEA staged halted at 10% due to increased 5xx and p99; rolled back to v2.7.4. Action: revert batching tweak and run longer soak."
DeployBot: thread closed by automation after rollback. If follow-up needed, reopen thread.
